verdict.rationale: skills.sh is a skills registry with a leaderboard and an installer CLI, so event webhooks (for example, notifications on skill publishes or updates) are a reasonable thing to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions webhooks, event subscriptions, or any push notification mechanism. The pack covers only CLI commands (add/use/list/update/remove/init) and a community request for a REST API, which suggests even pull-based programmatic access is absent.
